query: Here, we carried out DMS, a high-throughput experimental technique, of the tip domain of the T7 phage RBP (tail fiber) to uncover molecular determinants of activity and host range. We developed ORACLE (Optimized Recombination, Accumulation, and Library Expression), a high-throughput, locus-specific, phage genome engineering method to create a large, unbiased library of phage variants at a targeted gene locus.
